class.name: WaveFunctionCollapse
class.brief_description: Generates a grid where every neighbouring pair of states is one you allowed.

method.name: allow
method.description: Allows [param neighbour] on the [param direction] side of [param state]. The mirrored pair is allowed too, so a wall facing north always has its neighbour facing south.

method.name: allow_all
method.description: Allows the two states to touch on any side.

method.name: generate
method.description:
Returns the states of a [param size] grid in row-major order, so cell [code](x, y)[/code] is at index [code]y * size.x + x[/code]. The same seed and rules always give the same grid.
Returns an empty array when the rules leave some cell with no legal state. That is normal for wave function collapse; retry with a different seed.

method.name: get_weight
method.description: Returns the relative likelihood of [param state], [code]1.0[/code] unless set.

method.name: is_allowed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param neighbour] may sit on the [param direction] side of [param state].

method.name: set_weight
method.description: Sets how often [param state] is picked relative to the others. Must be positive.
